category: probability and stochastic processes / random processes
canonical_claim: Let H_N be an N by N complex Hermitian matrix with GUE law having density proportional to exp(-(N/2) Tr(H_N^2)), so that the limiting spectral edge is 2. If lambda_max(H_N) is its largest eigenvalue, then N^(2/3) (lambda_max(H_N) - 2) converges in distribution as N tends to infinity to the beta-2 Tracy-Widom law F_2; for every real s, F_2(s) is the Fredholm determinant of the Airy kernel on L2(s, infinity).
